_comment: Copy to allreader-mcp.local.json and fill in. That name is gitignored.
_token: From a paired device: POST /enroll on the sync server, or `allreader-sync pair` for the first one. Revocable.
_master_key: The 32-byte library key, base64 — the same value the pairing QR carries. NOT revocable: anything holding this can read everything, for as long as it holds it.
